inputs.52.text: Modern flat-colour anime illustration in the style of a cute mobile-game mascot key visual: bold, clean dark outlines of even weight, bright flat cel colours filled edge to edge, one simple step of soft lavender shading, crisp edges everywhere. A thick stack of hand-drawn manga manuscript pages, the edges of many sheets showing along the side, seen from slightly above. The top page is a black-and-white ink manga page with screentone, divided into four panels by bold black borders. The largest panel at the top shows a big whale folded from paper, crisp origami facets, swimming above the rooftops of a rainy town, its one small round eye gentle and soft, looking toward the viewer. Small panels below show rain on rooftops and a girl looking up. Clean white paper, black ink, grey screentone. The object alone, centred and filling most of the frame, on a plain warm off-white background, even soft daylight, a faint soft shadow beneath it.
